albumInformation: Started in March of 2009 by Jerry Cooper, an avid guitar player with 40+ years of experience. While blues is his main drive, any genre that uses a guitar can benefit from his creativity.Greg Pappas (originally born in Cancun, Mexico and now living in Zaragoza, Spain) was at this time the vocalist for this group. Known as the "Chairman of the Board" in Spain, he is known worldwide for his powerful vocals, inspiring lyrics, and speed painting. Please reference his videos on YouTube.Frank Nelson joined our group in August of 2009 with the intent of completing some projects which had become stalled. He helped put the projects together, reconstructing the drum tracks & adding keyboard tracks as necessary. Mixdown & mastering of the project was also handled by him.Greg left us a couple of months later. He stays pretty busy. But we managed to get noticed by another vocalist.Brad Wilson joined our group & did most of the vocals for the rest of this ongoing project. Ha also added some amazing harmonica tracks to a lot of our songs. He is currently a member of our band and we hope he stays with us for a long time to help us with our ongoing project.
